verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents is code-first: agents are built and deployed as Python or Node.js programs, and an official CLI is documented and verified running. That gives programmatic access to the core build/deploy work that the browser-based Agent Builder UI also offers. But nothing in the evidence states or shows API/UI parity, so it is unproven whether every UI action, including Agent Builder and LiveKit Cloud dashboard functions, has an API or CLI equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a documented management/REST API covering Cloud dashboard and Agent Builder operations, and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Agents framework lets you add any Python or Node.js program to LiveKit rooms as full realtime participants.
Build and deploy a simple voice assistant with Python or Node.js in less than 10 minutes.
LiveKit Agent Builder to prototype and deploy agents directly in your browser without writing code
LiveKit is built for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
